hero.title: Special Education Fund
hero.description: How much Aparri collected for public schools each year, and how much was spent.

content.intro: The Special Education Fund (SEF) comes from an extra 1% tax on land and buildings, paid together with the regular real property tax. The money can only be used for public schools, such as building and repairing classrooms, school supplies, sports, and extra teachers. The Local School Board decides how it is spent.

terms.description: Money from an extra 1% real property tax that can only be used for public schools.
The group that decides how the fund is used. It is led by the mayor and the schools division superintendent, with teachers, parents and other members.
How much of the money collected in a year was spent in that same year. Money not spent stays in the fund for later use.
